The S2 known-red image: the suite-base image with UPSTREAM MAIN's
omarchy-migrate installed (the omarchy-pr-red fixture) plus the same
declarative behavior check. The check MUST FAIL — upstream main exits
1 silently, not 2 with the message — proving the check surfaces a
wrong change per-check (the charly equivalent of per-file failure
surfacing). Expected to fail by design.

## Composition

This box composes:

- `omarchy-pr-red`
